source_page_content:
Claims for Cargo Damage

Section 8.2 — Notice of Damage

Visible damage must be noted on the delivery receipt when the cargo is accepted. A written claim for damage must be submitted within 14 calendar days after delivery. The claim must include photographs of the damaged cargo and packaging, together with an inspection report when one is available.

Section 8.3 — Excluded Causes

Responsibility does not extend to damage caused by inadequate packaging supplied by the shipper or by an inherent defect in the cargo.
declaration_requirement: Submit photographs of the damaged cargo and packaging, and an inspection report when available; note visible damage on the delivery receipt at acceptance.
